title: Projektetage Column Text Morph
description: Fix projektetage tiles-to-text transition: all column tiles should morph into one shared label per column (not first tile to text then text to stack). Use column ghost bridge slide and columnMorphId labels.
summary: Removed the `catalogue-column-ghosts` bridge arrangement (11 slides again). Column→label morph is direct: `catalogue-focus` keeps hidden `columnMorphId` ghosts alongside tiles; `catalogue-labels` uses the same ids on label slots so reveal.js morphs ghost→label in one step without a per-tile or bridge slide.
